heuristics.name: Clarity
heuristics.description: Can users immediately understand the purpose of this screen and what they should do next? Clear labeling, obvious affordances, and unambiguous messaging.

heuristics.name: Cognitive Load
heuristics.description: How much mental effort is required to use this screen? Higher scores indicate lower cognitive load. Considers information density, decision complexity, and visual noise.

heuristics.name: Visual Hierarchy
heuristics.description: Are the most important elements visually prominent? Effective use of size, color, contrast, spacing, and typography to guide attention.

heuristics.name: Feedback & Status
heuristics.description: Does the UI confirm actions and clearly communicate system state? Loading states, success/error messages, progress indicators, and state changes.

heuristics.name: Accessibility
heuristics.description: Inclusive design quality. Color contrast, text size, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, touch target sizes, and consideration for various abilities.

heuristics.name: Conversion Strength
heuristics.description: For CTAs and value propositions, how compelling is the presentation? Persuasive copy, visual emphasis, perceived value, reduced friction, and clear benefit communication.
